import json,numpy as np
D=[json.loads(l) for l in open('exploracion.jsonl')]

U=np.array(D[0]['secuencia']+D[1]['secuencia'],float);Y=np.array(D[0]['lecturas']+D[1]['lecturas'])
T=len(U)
ch=[t for t in range(1,T) if abs(Y[t]-Y[t-1]).max()>0.15];print(ch)
# regress dY at change t on actions at t-k for k in 0..7
for lagset in [range(0,4),range(1,5),range(2,6),range(3,7),range(4,8)]:
  X=[];dY=[]
  for t in ch[1:]:
    X.append(np.concatenate([U[t-k] for k in lagset]));dY.append(Y[t]-Y[t-4])
  X=np.array(X);dY=np.array(dY)
  c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dY,rcond=None);print(list(lagset),np.abs(X@c-dY).mean(),c.round(2).T)
